# Lucide icons used by GumShelf

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
Pinned revision: 03f11e2d6adc319ea21e9a1d5820a99cd3767257

See LICENSE for Lucide ISC and Feather-derived MIT terms. Raw SVG geometry is preserved; the existing app wrapper supplies size, stroke and accessible button labels. No icon package/runtime dependency is installed. SymbolKit template exports supplied by the user were inspected but are not bundled.
